notes: Ran into the known IP Block on Server 1 with 0 credits again and again (T1, T2, T4, T5, T10), getting tagged and stopped every time, and never clicked for credits; the corp scored Remastered Edition, Degree Mill and Bellona from that server without any contest.

Scored steadily from the iced remote and used Exchange of Information well (T4), but left R&D unprotected until T7 while MaxX ran it four times a turn, giving up Beale, Breaking News and GFI; the T4 Hard-Hitting News tags were never punished.

Kept re-accessing the known Obokata Protocol (Pinhole Threading T5, Mad Dash plus a run T6) and never ran Server 3, where Send a Message was being advanced; on T8 and T9 it clicked for credits up to 15 with a 5-card grip instead of stealing Obokata through the unrezzed ice or contesting the final Send a Message.

Left Hostile Takeover overnight in a naked remote (T2), then sat on 20-26 credits clicking for credits and discarding on T5-T7 instead of scoring; once it started, it scored steadily behind Hadrian's Wall but lost Private Security Force to Inside Job (T8).

Solid game: a good Turntable swap of 15 Minutes for Project Beale (T8), a Stimhack HQ run, and steady R&D pressure; the odd spots are the T6 HQ run where Black Orchestra was installed but Enigma was not broken, and some loose credit clicks while carrying tags.

Clicked for credits three times a turn on T10-T14 while holding 11-23 credits and discarding every turn, played Audacity (T17) with nothing installed and trashed its whole HQ, and forfeited a 3-point GFI to rez Archer (T15); it left the R&D ice unrezzed while Project Atlas and GFI were stolen.

Strong Account Siphon (T3) and repeated HQ runs through unrezzed ice for 5 points; the slight inefficiencies were paying 9 for Femme Fatale on the R&D Enigma and never using it, and letting two Private Security Force scores through before fetching Crypsis with Special Order (T14).

From T6 to T11 it clicked for credits every turn up to 35 with a full grip, never running or installing, while the corp advanced and scored Accelerated Beta Test twice and Project Vitruvius twice from lightly iced remotes.

Played Biotic Labor three times (T2, T14, T22) just to click for credits at a net loss, and spent many turns clicking for credits while broke; agendas sat in HQ behind unrezzed ice, so Project Vitruvius, Efficiency Committee and Accelerated Beta Test were stolen, and the Director Haas' Pet Project installs (T10) trashed its own cards.

Efficient: fast-scored Hostile Takeover twice, used Border Control and Blue Sun well, and scored SDS Drone Deployment and SSL Endorsement behind ice; minor waste was clicking for credits at 10+ credits and overdrawing off Rashida (T7).

Scored GFI and two Project Beales cleanly behind Enigma, but left R&D unprotected until T8 while the runner ran it four times a turn (AR-Enhanced Security stolen), and drew or clicked for credits on T2 and T4 while holding 8-12 credits and discarding.

It won, but slowly: the HQ ice was never rezzed and agendas were sitting there, yet the runner spent T5-T9 building and clicking for credits without running HQ, only finding SSL Endorsement on T14; Street Peddler trashing Dirty Laundry and Hippo (T5) was also wasteful.

Spent most turns clicking for credits and discarding with 10-16 credits, played Psychographics with no tags (T4, T21), and burned clicks and credits trashing Liberated Account repeatedly (T12-T13) until broke; it scored only Project Beale while two Bellonas sat in HQ and were stolen (T18, T21).

Only ran the open R&D, sitting at 4 credits with a full grip that was discarded each turn, and never once contested Server 2 behind its single ice, where Project Atlas, Offworld Office and GFI were advanced over several turns and scored.

It won, but took 25 turns against a corp stuck at 0-3 credits for most of the game: it spent many clicks on tag removal and drawing, facechecked the HQ Tollbooth (T15), and was slow to get a decoder for Server 1 (Houdini T23); it used Film Critic for points via clicks instead of plain steals.

Bizarre play: Consulting Visit for Audacity with nothing installed trashed all of HQ (T3), Dedication Ceremony put advancement counters on Black Orchestra and Aeneas Informant (T4, T15), and it paid 2 credits to trash a free Aeneas Informant 2-3 times a turn for many turns; it never scored, and Above the Law went into a remote it could not afford to rez ice for (T17) and was stolen.

Facechecked HQ with Account Siphon on T1 and the remote Resistor on T4, then paid 9 for Femme Fatale on the HQ Enigma and never ran HQ again, even with the corp at 0 credits for 10 turns; it spent the late game on the Joshua B. tag and remove-tag loop and won slowly through Data Leak Reversal and Archives.

Hansei Review binned Obokata Protocol into an unprotected Archives, where it was stolen (T6); Longevity Serum sat in HQ behind unrezzed ice and was stolen (T2); Divert Power was played twice with nothing to derez (T2), and the corp drew passively to 19 credits before installing anything on T6.

Used the Sensie Actors Union engine and scored Beale and two GFIs quickly from the Wraparound remote; it overdrew and discarded heavily, and ran its credits down to 0 (T7-T9) with an agenda behind a single ice, which a more active runner might have punished.

Sat at 0 credits with Argus tags from T1 to T7, never clicking for credits or removing tags, and ran the tiny HQ four times a turn seeing the same Economic Warfare and Rashida Jaheem; it never contested GFI in Server 1 and was flatlined by High-Profile Target on T8 in a foreseeable way.
